invite.description: You are invited to join {{organization}} as {{role}}.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new link.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this organization.

onboarding.title: Create an organization
onboarding.description: Your account does not belong to any organization yet. Create one, or open an invitation link from a colleague.

overview.title: Welcome to InsightAI
overview.description: The platform foundation is in place. Data features arrive in the next phases.

organization.title: Organization settings
organization.name: Organization name
organization.timezoneHint: Used for periods such as "this month".
organization.readOnly: You can view but not change these settings.

members.title: Members
members.description: People with access to this organization.
members.name: Name
members.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the organization? They lose access immediately.

invitations.title: Invitation links
invitations.description: Create a link and send it to a colleague. Each link can be used once.
invitations.created: Invitation link created. Copy it now: it is only shown once.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.description: Important changes in this organization. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid. Please check and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.QUERY_REJECTED: This could not be run on the data.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Upload CSV/Excel files, review their structure and browse the data.
datasets.name: Dataset name
datasets.empty: No datasets yet. Create one and upload a file to get started.
datasets.archiveConfirm: Archive dataset "{{name}}"? It will be hidden, but its data and history are kept.
datasets.noData: This dataset has no data yet. Upload a file to get started.

upload.title: Upload data
upload.hint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to 100 MB, 2 million rows, 300 columns. Each upload creates a new version.

profile.failed: The data profile could not be computed.

warnings.COLUMNS_RENAMED: Some column names were normalized (lower case, no accents, unique)
warnings.EXTRA_CELLS_IGNORED: Some rows had more values than the header; extra values were ignored
warnings.INVALID_VALUES: Some values could not be converted to the column type and were stored as empty (the original value is kept)

importErrors.EMPTY_FILE: The file is empty or only has a header row.
importErrors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than 2 million rows.
importErrors.TOO_MANY_COLUMNS: The file has more than 300 columns.
importErrors.MALFORMED_FILE: The file could not be read: it is corrupted or in the wrong format.
importErrors.UNSAFE_ARCHIVE: The Excel file expands to an unsafe size and was rejected.
importErrors.SHEET_NOT_FOUND: The requested worksheet was not found.
importErrors.UNKNOWN_COLUMN: Column type settings refer to a column that does not exist.
importErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR: A system error occurred during import. Please try again.

quality.reportHint: Every new version is checked automatically against the rules below.
quality.checkFailed: This check failed because of a system error. Run it again.
quality.issuesSample: Showing a sample of {{shown}} of {{total}} failing rows.
quality.rulesHint: They apply to every version; changes take effect at the next check.
quality.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule "{{rule}}"? Past check results are kept.

ruleHint.not_null: Every row must have a value in this column.
ruleHint.unique: The selected columns together must not repeat.
ruleHint.regex: Text values must match the pattern.
ruleHint.allowed_values: Values must be in the list.
ruleHint.range: Numbers or dates must be within the range.
ruleHint.length: The number of characters must be within the range.
ruleHint.expression: Every row must satisfy the expression (e.g. total = quantity * price).
ruleHint.foreign_key: Values must exist in a column of another dataset.

editor.name: Name
editor.rangeHint: Numbers with a decimal point (1234.5); dates as yyyy-MM-dd. One side may be empty.
editor.lengthHint: Number of characters. One side may be empty.
editor.exprHint: Use column names, comparisons, AND/OR, + − × ÷, IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL…
editor.exprNotBoolean: The expression must produce true/false (it produces {{type}}).
editor.thresholdHint: Passes when at least this % of rows are valid.

cleaning.sourceHint: The source version is never modified; the result is a new version.
cleaning.noSuggestions: No suggestions — the data looks fine.
cleaning.noCheckYet: There is no quality check result for this version yet.

rationale.TRIM_WHITESPACE: Values in {{columns}} have leading or trailing spaces.
rationale.UNIFY_VARIANTS: {{groups}} value(s) in {{column}} are written in several ways.
rationale.PARSE_DATES: Invalid dates in {{column}} use another layout ({{formats}}).
rationale.FILL_MEDIAN: {{count}} missing value(s) in {{column}} can be filled with the median.
rationale.REMOVE_DUPLICATE_ROWS: {{count}} row(s) are copies of an earlier row.
rationale.REMOVE_DUPLICATE_KEYS: Several rows share the same {{columns}}; keep the first of each.

cleaning.recipeHint: Steps run in order. Preview to see exactly how many rows change.
cleaning.emptyRecipe: No steps yet. Add suggestions or add an operation yourself.
cleaning.applyConfirm: Create a new version from these steps? The current version is not modified and stays active until you activate the new one.
cleaning.applied: The new version was created and is being checked again.
cleaning.noChanges: These steps do not change any row.
cleaning.sampleHint: Sample of {{n}} changed rows (old values struck through, new values in green).

errors.CLEANING_FAILED: The steps could not be run on this data.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Cleaning failed because of a system error. Please try again.

opHint.trim_whitespace: Remove spaces at the start and end of text values.
opHint.change_case: Change the letter case of text columns.
opHint.replace_values: Unify different spellings into one value.
opHint.fill_null: Fill empty cells with a constant or a value computed from the data.
opHint.cast_column: Read the original file values again as the new type.
opHint.parse_date: Keep valid dates, try other layouts for empty/invalid values.
opHint.drop_rows: Remove rows matching a condition or failing a rule.
opHint.deduplicate: Keep one row per group of duplicates.
opHint.rename_column: Rename a column (later steps use the new name).
opHint.drop_column: Leave the column out of the new version.

editor.noTextColumns: There is no text column at this step.
editor.collapseInner: Collapse runs of inner spaces into one
editor.mappingHint: One per line: old value => new value (empty right side clears the value).
editor.valueHint: Numbers with a decimal point; dates as yyyy-MM-dd; true/false.
editor.formatsHint: Valid dates are kept as they are.
editor.conditionHint: Rows where the expression is true are removed (unknown keeps the row).
editor.keyColumnsHint: No column selected = compare whole rows.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Every version is kept. The active version is what analytics use; activate an older one to roll back.
versions.rollbackConfirm: Roll back to version {{n}}? Newer versions are kept.
